benchmark-all                  Run all benchmarks
benchmark-baseline             Build (once) the origin/main compiler that `benchmark/ab.ts` compares against
benchmark-cbor                 Run cbor ser/de benchmark (serde_cbor vs Wado core:cbor) over twitter/canada/catalog
benchmark-fts                  Run fts benchmark
benchmark-gale-gen             Run gale-gen benchmark (Gale generator throughput over the Rust grammar)
benchmark-gale-highlight-html  Run gale-highlight-html benchmark (HTML with embedded CSS/JS)
benchmark-http-routing         Run http-routing benchmark (wado serve vs Hono on Node.js and Bun vs Axum)
benchmark-json-canada          Run json-canada benchmark
benchmark-json-catalog         Run json-catalog benchmark
benchmark-json-twitter         Run json-twitter benchmark
benchmark-mandelbrot           Run mandelbrot benchmark
benchmark-microgpt             Run microgpt benchmark
benchmark-re                   Run re benchmark (regular expression search: Re vs Node's RegExp)
benchmark-sieve                Run sieve benchmark
benchmark-sqlite-parse         Run sqlite-parse benchmark
benchmark-syntax-highlight     Run syntax-highlight benchmark
benchmark-zlib                 Run zlib benchmark
build                          Check Rust crates (host + wasm32 targets)
build-wado-lsp-wasm            Build wado-lsp wasm + wado-vscode TS into wado-vscode/out/
build-wado-lsp-wasm-rust       Build the wado-lsp wasm32-wasip1 binary (-Os) into wado-vscode/out/ (Rust only)
build-wasmtime                 Build the wasmtime CLI from vendor/wasmtime (matches the embedded crate version)
check                          Run the corpus checks that finish in seconds
check-deps                     Fail if wasm-tools crates drift off wasmtime's generation (duplicate 0.x trees)
check-grammar                  Fail if Wado.g4 and the compiler's parser disagree on the stdlib + fixture corpus
check-highlight                Fail if Wado.g4 and the compiler's classifier colour the corpus differently
check-highlight-vocab          Fail if the Gale highlight query drifts from the compiler's syntax registries
check-minted-names             Fail if a compiler source outside name.rs formats a minted name
check-review-filters           Fail if a generated or vendored path is not filtered out of code review
check-rust-paths               Fail if a Rust file gained a `crate::` / `super::` path outside a module-level `use` item
check-spec-examples            Fail if a `wado` block in the specification does not quote an e2e fixture or a source file
check-unit-graph               Fail if a build that starts from another's target/ would recompile a unit of it: CI's handoffs, and a session's `cargo build` over the shared cache
check-wadopoet-vocabulary      Fail if package-wadopoet/src/vocabulary.wado drifts from the compiler's keywords and prelude
clean                          Clean all build artifacts
clean-wado-vscode-dev          Remove wado-vscode development symlink
clippy                         Run clippy checks
clippy-fix                     Run clippy auto-fix
cloudflare-build               Compile a Wado service and transpile it for the Cloudflare Worker
cloudflare-dev                 Serve the Cloudflare Worker locally (run cloudflare-build first)
doc-stdlib                     Generate stdlib reference docs (one file per core module, combined wasi)
eddy-review                    Review this branch with Eddy; arguments go to it (`--no-run` keeps it from building and running the code)
emi-calibrate                  Calibrate the EMI corpus: inject an empty `builtin::black_box(false)` guard, as a branch and as a loop, at every statement boundary of every e2e fixture, stdlib test module, example, and package and benchmark test, and keep the ones whose output is unmoved. Writes target/emi/{corpus,calibration}.txt. Knobs: WADO_EMI_JOBS, WADO_EMI_FILTER, WADO_EMI_ROOTS (fixtures,stdlib,example,package-cm-catalog,package-jade,package-marl,benchmark), WADO_EMI_LEVELS (O0,O1,O2,Os,O3), WADO_EMI_SHARD (k/n), WADO_EMI_LIMIT, WADO_EMI_OUT.
emi-mutate                     Mutate the calibrated EMI corpus: at every statement boundary, behind an undecidable guard in each shape the source was calibrated for, write to, read, and take a reference to every binding in scope, then report any source whose output moves. Reads target/emi/corpus.txt, so run emi-calibrate first. Writes target/emi/mutation.txt and the reduced mutants under target/emi/findings/.
emi-profile                    Compile the calibrated EMI corpus under profiles: each test-world source, and its empty-guard mutants, under the profile its tests record and WADO_EMI_PROFILES random ones (default 2), then report any whose output moves. Reads target/emi/corpus.txt, so run emi-calibrate first. Writes target/emi/profile.txt and each finding's program and reduced profile under target/emi/findings/.
extract-gale-descriptors       Regenerate Gale's ANTLR4 descriptor corpus (all categories, or those named)
format                         Format Rust, Markdown, and Wado files
format-md                      Format Markdown files
format-rust                    Format Rust files
format-wado                    Format Wado files
gen-affine-matrix              Regenerate the affine_matrix_* e2e fixtures: an affine value moved by each consumer in each context it runs in
ghcr-login                     Write ghcr.io auth into ~/.docker/config.json from a GitHub token (cloud GITHUB_TOKEN / local gh keyring)
hello                          Compile example/hello.wado to WAT and Wasm
hello-run                      Run example/hello.wado
hello-run-wasmtime             Compile and run hello.wado directly with wasmtime
install-wado-vscode-dev        Install wado-vscode extension for development
jco-bench                      Benchmark a Wado program on Node via jco (compile -f no-wide-arithmetic, transpile, self-time 3x)
jco-deps                       Install the released jco for the vendor-free pipeline (scripts/jco)
jco-hello-released             Compile, transpile (released jco), and run example/hello.wado on Node
jco-transpile-released         Transpile a Wado .wasm component to JS via the released jco
list-rust-paths                List the inline `crate::` / `super::` paths the named Rust files carry
list-todo                      List E2E test fixtures whose module or tests are marked #![TODO] / #[TODO]
loam-oracle-deps               Install the pinned Node runtimes Loam runs as oracles (package-loam/package.json)
loam-ort-inspect               Report what onnxruntime makes of a model: the transformers that changed it, placements, the optimized graph, and a profiled run
on-task-done                   Format, clippy-fix, update golden fixtures, regenerate stdlib docs, and test
on-task-started                Install project development tools
oracle-gale                    Run the ANTLR4 jar on a grammar and the input on stdin (package-gale/scripts/antlr4_oracle.wado)
oracle-gale-regen              Regenerate Gale's oracle-pinned driver tests (sqlite, json, or all)
oracle-gale-selftest           Check the ANTLR4 oracle's answers and refusals against the corpus grammars
oracle-gale-typescript         List where Gale's TypeScript parse tree for a file differs from the ANTLR4 jar's
oracle-re                      Regenerate Re's oracle-pinned tests from Node's RegExp (package-re/scripts/oracle.mjs)
playground-web-build           Build the client-side browser playground assets into wado-playground/web/
playground-web-package         Package the built playground runtime into wado-playground/web/wado-playground-web.tar.gz (the site consumes this release asset)
playground-web-serve           Serve the browser playground on http://127.0.0.1:8088 (run playground-web-build first)
playground-web-test            Browser smoke test for the playground (installs playwright-core; needs Chromium 137+)
release-build                  Build the wado CLI with the release profile (LTO, fully optimized)
report-const-regions           Count the compile-time regions that survive optimization, by cause
report-wasm-size               Build all languages and report Wasm sizes
suite-jade                     Regenerate Jade's tests from the JSON Schema Test Suite's Draft 2020-12 cases in vendor/JSON-Schema-Test-Suite
sync-onnx-data                 Copy onnx.proto and the ONNX test data Loam's tests name out of the vendor/onnx submodule
sync-proto-corpus              Copy the .proto files Grog's tests name out of the vendor/protobuf and vendor/onnx submodules
sync-vendor                    Sync vendor submodules (wasmtime pinned to Cargo.lock, others to latest)
test                           Check the spec examples, then run Rust crate tests
test-cov                       Run tests with coverage
test-cov-html                  Run tests with coverage (HTML report)
test-e2e                       Run the compiler's e2e fixtures at O2: the check for a compiler change
test-e2e-level                 Run the compiler's e2e fixtures at one other optimization level: O0, O1, O3 or Os; CI runs each, the development cycle none
test-format                    Run formatter invariant tests over the fixtures + stdlib corpus: idempotency, AST round-trip, and no comment drop. The corpus is not reformatted in place (fixtures double as parser tests), but it is the richest edge-case input.
test-fuel                      Measure the `test "fuel"` regions of benchmark/ at -O2, and fail on any difference from benchmark/fuel.json
test-gale-o2                   Run package-gale tests with -O2
test-hooks                     Run the Claude Code hook tests
test-log-levels                Run the core:log tier tests at one optimization level, each file at the tier-1 level it needs
test-pjrt                      Run wado-run-pjrt's programs on XLA's CPU plugin and compile them for a TPU, both plugins fetched and pinned
test-stdlib                    Run the stdlib (wado-compiler/lib) tests at one optimization level: O0, O1, O2, O3 or Os (default O2); later arguments go to `wado test`
test-stdlib-coverage           Run the stdlib tests under coverage at one optimization level (default O2) and fail on any difference from scripts/stdlib-coverage.json
test-wado                      Run Wado module tests; arguments go to `wado test`
test-wado-vscode               Run wado-vscode tests
test-web-glue                  Run example/web-browser on Node against jsdom, through package-web's glue
test262-re                     Regenerate Re's test262 syntax test and input corpus from vendor/test262, then the oracle tests
update-baselines               Rewrite the baselines CI holds a pull request to: scripts/stdlib-coverage.json (what the stdlib tests leave unrun) and benchmark/fuel.json (the fuel benchmarks), after recording the benchmarks' profiles again
update-bundled                 Rebuild bundled libm Wasm module
update-bundled-icu             Rebuild the bundled ICU component
update-docs-index              Regenerate the index of docs/README.md from the titles of the docs
update-golden-fixtures         Regenerate WIR golden fixtures
update-golden-format-fixtures  Regenerate format fixture golden files (clean, NIR, lower, optimize, WIR, WAT)
update-package-web             Regenerate package-web's DOM bindings and glue from the vendored WebIDL snapshot
update-rust-paths-baseline     Record the inline paths each Rust file still carries, ratcheting the baseline down
update-stdlib-core-wit         Regenerate the core:* stdlib submodules generated from WIT (core:kiln, core:eval, core:coverage, core:fuel, core:pjrt, core:process; facades are hand-written)
update-stdlib-wasi             Regenerate wasi stdlib from WIT files
update-wado-vscode-grammar     Regenerate wado-vscode syntax files from syntax.rs
update-wadopoet-vocabulary     Regenerate package-wadopoet/src/vocabulary.wado from the compiler's keywords and prelude
update-webidl-snapshot         Re-snapshot the WebIDL slice from @webref/idl into package-web/idl/dom.webidl.json
watch-wado-lsp-wasm            Watch wado-lsp + wado-vscode TS; keep wado-vscode/out/ continuously fresh
web-browser-demo               Build example/web-browser and serve it on http://127.0.0.1:8089
webidl-deps                    Install @webref/idl for the WebIDL snapshot (scripts/webidl)
</stdout>
